Can I get my ISC marks re-evaluated? 
Yes. CISCE first offers a recheck. Applications for re-evaluation must reach CISCE online within three days of the recheck results being declared. 
What Class 12 marks do I need for NITs through JEE Main? 
At least 75% in Class 12 (65% for SC and ST candidates), or a place in the top 20 percentile of your board, according to NTA. JoSAA publishes each board's top 20 percentile cut-off marks every year.

Every date on this page is taken from CBSE’s official date sheet, dated 6 November 2026. CBSE says it planned the schedule so that no two subjects a student has chosen fall on the same day, and so that the boards finish before the major entrance exams.

## Stream-wise schedule and preparation gaps 

How many days you get between papers matters more than the dates themselves. Here are the common subject combinations, with the gap before each paper. 

## Science (PCM) 
- Tue, 16 Feb Physics 
- Sat, 27 Feb Chemistry 11 days after the previous paper 
- Fri, 5 Mar English Core 6 days after the previous paper 
- Tue, 9 Mar Mathematics 4 days after the previous paper 

## Science (PCB) 
- Tue, 16 Feb Physics 
- Sat, 27 Feb Chemistry 11 days after the previous paper 
- Fri, 5 Mar English Core 6 days after the previous paper 
- Thu, 25 Mar Biology 20 days after the previous paper 

## Commerce with Maths 
- Tue, 23 Feb Accountancy 
- Fri, 5 Mar English Core 10 days after the previous paper 
- Tue, 9 Mar Mathematics 4 days after the previous paper 
- Tue, 16 Mar Economics 7 days after the previous paper 
- Thu, 1 Apr Business Studies 16 days after the previous paper 

## Humanities 
- Thu, 25 Feb Geography 
- Tue, 2 Mar Psychology 5 days after the previous paper 
- Fri, 5 Mar English Core 3 days after the previous paper 
- Tue, 16 Mar Economics 11 days after the previous paper 
- Fri, 19 Mar Political Science 3 days after the previous paper 
- Sat, 27 Mar History 8 days after the previous paper 
- Tue, 30 Mar Sociology 3 days after the previous paper 

Add your own optional subject (for example Physical Education, Computer Science or a language) from the full table below. 
MyUniMentor tip 
Use the long gaps for your hardest subjects. In PCM, the 11 days between Physics and Chemistry are your biggest block, and Mathematics comes 4 days after English; in PCB, you get 20 days between English and Biology. Plan backwards from each date, and keep the last two days before every paper for past papers only.

When does the CBSE Class 12 exam 2027 start? 
On Tuesday, 16 February 2027, with Physics (042). All papers start at 10:30 am IST. 
When is the CBSE Class 12 Maths exam 2027? 
Mathematics (041) and Applied Mathematics (241) are on Tuesday, 9 March 2027, from 10:30 am to 1:30 pm. 
When are Chemistry and Biology in CBSE Class 12 2027? 
Chemistry (043) is on Saturday, 27 February 2027, and Biology (044) is on Thursday, 25 March 2027. 
When is the English exam for CBSE Class 12 2027? 
English Core (301) and English Elective (001) are on Friday, 5 March 2027. 
When is the last CBSE Class 12 exam in 2027? 
The last papers are Retail (801) and Web Application (803) on Friday, 9 April 2027. Among the main subjects, Legal Studies (074) is on 8 April and Business Studies (054) on 1 April. 
When will CBSE Class 12 results 2027 come out? 
CBSE has not announced the date. For reference, it declared the 2026 Class 12 results on 13 May 2026.

MyUniMentor tip 
Mathematics comes first, on 17 February, so start full-length practice papers in December. After that, the five core papers are four to five days apart, which is enough for one subject at a time if your first revision is done by early February. Class 10 is also when you choose your stream. Our guide on choosing a stream after Class 10 can help.

When does the CBSE Class 10 exam 2027 start?

## ISC Class 12 timetable 2027: every paper, date and timing 

CISCE’s ISC (Class 12) exams 2027 begin on Tuesday, 9 February and end on Thursday, 8 April. Below is every paper with its date and time, from CISCE’s official timetable of 10 November 2026, along with reporting times, what you can take into the hall, and how rechecks work. 

By Om Garg , Founder, MyUniMentor · Updated 24 Nov 2026 · 6 min read 

## Key facts 

Tuesday, 9 February 2027 (Environmental Science, Western Music) 
Thursday, 8 April 2027 (Legal Studies) 
Most papers at 2:00 pm; Art papers at 9:00 am 
Be seated by 1:30 pm for 2:00 pm papers, and by 8:30 am for 9:00 am papers 
15 minutes, in addition to the writing time 
3 hours for every paper 
April or May 2027, on cisce.org 
10 November 2026, by CISCE 

Every date on this page is taken from CISCE’s official “ISC (Class XII) Year 2027 Examination Timetable and Instructions for Candidates”, available on cisce.org . 

## Main subjects at a glance 

Date Subject / paper Starts (IST) 
Wed, 10 Feb English – Paper 1 (English Language) 2:00 pm 
Mon, 15 Feb English – Paper 2 (Literature in English) 2:00 pm 
Thu, 18 Feb Economics 2:00 pm 
Wed, 24 Feb Chemistry – Paper 1 (Theory) 2:00 pm 
Fri, 26 Feb Accountancy 2:00 pm 
Mon, 1 Mar Mathematics 2:00 pm 
Wed, 3 Mar Physical Education 2:00 pm 
Mon, 8 Mar Physics – Paper 1 (Theory) 2:00 pm 
Thu, 11 Mar Business Studies 2:00 pm 
Fri, 12 Mar Geography 2:00 pm 
Mon, 15 Mar Biology – Paper 1 (Theory) 2:00 pm 
Wed, 17 Mar Computer Science – Paper 1 (Theory) 2:00 pm 
Fri, 19 Mar History 2:00 pm 
Thu, 25 Mar Sociology 2:00 pm 
Mon, 29 Mar Commerce 2:00 pm 
Wed, 31 Mar Psychology 2:00 pm 
Fri, 2 Apr Political Science 2:00 pm 
Thu, 8 Apr Legal Studies 2:00 pm 
MyUniMentor tip 
ISC starts a week before CBSE, and most papers are in the afternoon. Write your mock papers at 2 pm, not in the morning, so you are used to the timing. Physics, Biology and Computer Science all fall in March, so finish your first revision of them by the end of February. 

## Full ISC 2027 timetable

## What you can and cannot take into the hall 

- Allowed: your CISCE admission card, blue or black pens, pencils, scale, eraser, sharpener, colour pencils, drawing instruments, and a calculator of the type CISCE allows (Casio fx-82 MS or similar, or a basic calculator). 

- Not allowed: books or notes, mobile phones, smart watches, earbuds, AI or smart glasses, smart rings, smart or scanner pens, wallets and cash. 

## Results, recheck and re-evaluation 

CISCE will declare the ISC 2027 results in April or May 2027 on cisce.org. If you are not satisfied, you can apply online for a recheck ; the request must reach CISCE within four days of the results. After the recheck results, you can apply for re-evaluation within three days, only in the subjects you asked to recheck. Both are paid services. You can also take an improvement exam in up to three subjects in the same year. 

## After the boards 

Most entrance exams start soon after the boards. See every date on our entrance exam calendar , and read what to do when results come out . Not sure which course fits you? Try our psychometric test or book a free counselling session .

## Questions students ask 
Still unsure? Call or WhatsApp +91 74175 57070 . 
When does the ISC 2027 exam start? 
On Tuesday, 9 February 2027, with Environmental Science and Western Music Paper 1. Most papers start at 2:00 pm. 
When is the ISC 2027 English exam? 
English Paper 1 (English Language) is on Wednesday, 10 February 2027, and English Paper 2 (Literature in English) on Monday, 15 February 2027. 
When are ISC 2027 Physics, Chemistry and Maths? 
Chemistry Paper 1 is on 24 February, Mathematics on 1 March and Physics Paper 1 on 8 March 2027, all at 2:00 pm. 
What time should I reach for ISC exams? 
You must be seated by 1:30 pm for papers that start at 2:00 pm, and by 8:30 am for Art papers that start at 9:00 am. Reading time is an extra 15 minutes. 
When will ISC 2027 results be declared? 
CISCE says the ISC 2027 results will be declared in April or May 2027 on cisce.org.

## ICSE Class 10 timetable 2027: every paper, date and timing 

CISCE’s ICSE (Class 10) exams 2027 begin on Monday, 15 February with English Language and end on Wednesday, 31 March. Below is every paper with its date and time, from CISCE’s official timetable of 10 November 2026. 

By Om Garg , Founder, MyUniMentor · Updated 24 Nov 2026 · 5 min read 

## Key facts 

Monday, 15 February 2027 (English Language) 
Wednesday, 31 March 2027 (Economics, French and Sanskrit as Group II electives) 
Most papers at 10:15 am; Art papers at 9:00 am 
Be seated by 9:45 am for 10:15 am papers, and by 8:30 am for 9:00 am papers 
15 minutes, in addition to the writing time 
April or May 2027, on cisce.org 
10 November 2026, by CISCE 

Every date on this page is taken from CISCE’s official “ICSE (Class X) Year 2027 Examination Timetable and Instructions for Candidates”, available on cisce.org . 

## Main subjects at a glance 

Date Subject / paper Starts (IST) 
Mon, 15 Feb English Language – English Paper 1 10:15 am 
Thu, 18 Feb Literature in English – English Paper 2 10:15 am 
Mon, 22 Feb Mathematics 10:15 am 
Fri, 26 Feb History & Civics – H.C.G. Paper 1 10:15 am 
Mon, 1 Mar Geography – H.C.G. Paper 2 10:15 am 
Thu, 4 Mar Hindi 10:15 am 
Mon, 8 Mar Physics – Science Paper 1 10:15 am 
Fri, 12 Mar Chemistry – Science Paper 2 10:15 am 
Mon, 15 Mar Biology – Science Paper 3 10:15 am

Fri, 19 Mar Languages: Ao-Naga, Assamese, Bengali, Bhasha Indonesia, Dzongkha, Garo, Gujarati, Kannada, Khasi, Lepcha, Mizo, Malayalam, Marathi, Nepali, Odia, Punjabi, Sanskrit, Tamil, Tangkhul, Telugu, Urdu, Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Modern Armenian, Portuguese, Spanish, Thai, Tibetan 10:15 am 
Thu, 25 Mar Environmental Science (Group II Elective) 10:15 am 
Mon, 29 Mar Commercial Studies (Group II Elective) 10:15 am 
Wed, 31 Mar Economics (Group II Elective) 10:15 am 
MyUniMentor tip 
The three Science papers come one after another in March, with three to four days between them. Finish your first full revision of all three by the end of February, and use the gaps for past papers. After the boards, the next big decision is your stream; read our guide on choosing a stream after Class 10 .
